title: Welcome to The_89_Project
excerpt: This is the first post on your new blog. A fresh start with modern, simple technology.
content: Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh, Welcome to your new blog, The_89_Project. This is the beginning of something special. ## Getting Started To create a new post: 1. Visit the Admin Panel 2. Fill in the title and content 3. Click Publish Your post will appear immediately on the homepage. ## Customization You can customize the look by editing: - `src/public/style.css` - colors, layout, typography - `src/views/` - templates ## Deployment When ready to deploy to blogs.rosyada.my.id: - Copy files to your hosting - Run `npm install` - Set PORT environment variable if needed - Point your domain to this server May this blog be a benefit. Barakallah. — With love
